primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants with improvement in fibrosis or NASH at Week 24.
efficacy_outcome: Improvement rates were 30.6% (10 mg), 24.0% (20 mg), and 26.5% (40 mg) vs 14.3% with placebo; corresponding p-values were 0.055, 0.245, and 0.129.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 3/49 (10 mg), 7/50 (20 mg), 6/49 (40 mg), and 9/49 (placebo); deaths: 1, 0, 0, and 1, respectively.
